extracted.name: Cauliflower Salad
extracted.description: My absolute favorite Cauliflower Salad recipe is made with raw cauliflower, bacon and onion with and a sweet basil dressing that will have you hooked!
ingredient_lines: 1 head romaine lettuce (, chopped, or any leafy greens)
1/4 of a red onion (, chopped, or sweet onion, more if desired)
fresh cracked black pepper (, to taste)
instruction_lines: Mix dressing ingredients together. For best results, refrigerate dressing for at least an hour or up to 5 days ahead of time.
Add salad ingredients to a bowl. Toss with desired amount of dressing. Enjoy.
categories: How to make a cauliflower salad
